method: This VM, not a device. Headless Chrome 148.0.7778.96 at 1280x720, SwiftShader software GL (ANGLE, Vulkan 1.3.0, SwiftShader Device Subzero). The governor starts software at quality 4; these runs ended at quality 5 because frame time stayed over 21 ms. Demo bot, story=0. over33 means frames longer than 33.4 ms. avgFps and avgFightFps are the mean of each rep last-120-frame fps, the same fields as docs/stage2/perf.json. Not comparable to that file: different machine. Stage 1 and Stage 2 were not re-timed here.
ipad: UNMEASURED: for Jason. Open the githack link with ?stage=3&s3=1, play through to the boss, and note stutter plus the PLACEHOLDER ART tag.
notes: S3-R resets the meter when rooftop zone 2 locks, then samples 30 s. Rep 2 had reached zone 3 by the end of that window.
Headless Chrome does not focus Phaser, so the capture dispatches one window focus event. That is the production blur-resume path, and it keeps the hidden-tab pause from freezing the clock.
